constraints: composite FK (practice_session_id, student_id) -> practice_sessions(id, student_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK question_group_id -> question_groups(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FK question_group_attempt_id -> question_group_attempts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK question_group_item_id -> question_group_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FK question_attempt_id -> question_attempts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

child_attempt_rule: Create four ordinary QuestionAttempt rows in a,b,c,d order, with consecutive session attempt_number values, AUTO_EVALUATED status, score 1.0/0.0 per child, response_time_seconds=null, hint_count=0. Link them to the parent through question_group_attempt_items.
transaction_rule: Parent attempt, four child attempts, four attempt-item links, and all four mastery projections are one transaction. Any failure rolls back everything.
